Implementation of lib/newproj/newproj_remote.sh; it [[fb-lib-newproj-remote|serves|newproj_remote.sh is the concrete file the remote bead names.]]. It holds the selection globals NEWPROJ_GITHUB (off|private|public), NEWPROJ_RU (on|off) and NEWPROJ_GITHUB_OWNER; newproj_remote_parse_flag (--github[=private|public], --gh-private, --gh-public, --no-github, --github-owner=ORG, --ru, --no-ru); newproj_remote_init_defaults (flag > env > setting > off); newproj_remote_owner (the explicit owner, else 'gh api user -q .login', cached); newproj_ru_config, which asks ru itself ('ru config' prints its resolved PROJECTS_DIR= and LAYOUT=) instead of parsing ru's file, and newproj_ru_layout; newproj_projects_dir (MACACFS_PROJECTS_DIR > ACFS_PROJECTS_DIR > newproj.projects_dir > ru's PROJECTS_DIR > /data/projects if present > ~/Projects); newproj_default_project_dir (flat base/NAME, owner-repo base/OWNER/NAME, full base/github.com/OWNER/NAME, else base/NAME); newproj_layout_parent_creatable and newproj_ensure_layout_parent (create only the layout folders beneath an existing base); newproj_remote_preflight, which lists every problem before anything is created (--ru without a GitHub remote, ru or gh missing, gh unauthenticated, owner unresolved, OWNER/NAME already taken, no git identity); newproj_remote_scan_public (refuses personal paths and secrets in a public repo); newproj_remote_ensure_commit; newproj_remote_publish ('gh repo create OWNER/NAME --private|--public --source=. --remote=origin --push', or just a push when origin already exists); newproj_remote_ru ('ru add --from-cwd --non-interactive [--private]', then checks 'ru list --json'); and newproj_remote_finish, which on any failure keeps everything local, prints the manual commands from _newproj_manual_hint, never retries and never deletes. Its settings come from [[fb-lib-config-impl|calls|newproj_remote.sh sources lib/config.sh and reads newproj.* through config_effective.]], and newproj.sh hands its resolved values to the embedded Python, so it [[fb-lib-newproj-core-impl|couples-with|The bash resolver and the Python bootstrap must agree, so NEWPROJ_DEFAULT_PROJECTS_DIR, NEWPROJ_RU_LAYOUT and the MACACFS_NEWPROJ_*_DEFAULT variables are a shared contract.]].
